build_composed_pipeline: build a composed diffusion pipeline by instantiating ComposedPipelineBase subclass with model path and server args
add_standard_t2i_stages: add standard text-to-image pipeline stages including text encoding, latent prep, denoising, and decoding
add_standard_ti2i_stages: add standard image-to-image pipeline stages with optional text or image encoding prompt support
add_standard_ti2v_stages: add standard image-to-video pipeline stages with configurable image VAE encoding position
run_pipeline_forward: run the composed pipeline forward pass on a batch to generate images or video output
